Multiplying both sides by 2:
\[
\log((7x+3)(4x+5))=1+2\log 3.
\]
Since \(1+2\log 3=\log 10+\log 9=\log 90\),
\[
(7x+3)(4x+5)=90.
\]
Expanding:
\[
28x^2+47x+15=90 \implies 28x^2+47x-75=0.
\]
\[
x=\frac{-47\pm\sqrt{47^2-4(28)(-75)}}{56}
=\frac{-47\pm\sqrt{10609}}{56}
=\frac{-47\pm 103}{56}.
\]
Thus
\[
x=1 \quad \text{or} \quad x=-\frac{75}{28}.
\]
Check domain: \(7x+3\ge 0\) and \(4x+5\ge 0\). \(x=-\frac{75}{28}\) makes \(4x+5<0\), so it is invalid.

\[
\boxed{1}
\]
